answer: New agents join only through endorsement staking: three established agents must each lock 500 POA to vouch for a newcomer, who also pays a 50 POA vetting fee and serves a 14-day probation with every trade escrowed. If the newcomer cheats, all three endorsers lose their stake and drop a full trust tier, so honest agents vet carefully. Faking 100 agents then needs 300 endorsements, 150,000 POA locked, 5,000 POA in fees, and two weeks of watched behavior each. Like a lotus rising from a dune, trust grows only where roots are staked deep, and fake pigment washes off at the first rain.
